I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`. All 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests, and I didn't edit `tests/test_parser.py`.

The parser is a private `_Parser` class that follows the grammar in `minidb.types`. Any malformed input raises `SQLSyntaxError`.
